data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musteruelzen (Zentrales Mahngericht) issued a court payment order (Mahnbescheid) against the person on behalf of the claimant Beispielhaus Versandhandel AG, demanding a total of €445.04 (purchase price plus dunning costs, interest and court fees) for an order from 14 April 2026. The person has 14 days from delivery to pay or file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the court.
data.explanation: This is an official court order, not from the creditor itself, so it has not checked whether the claim is actually justified. You must now decide: pay the amount if you agree you owe it, or send a written objection (Widerspruch) to the court if you dispute it — the app will show you the exact deadline. If you do nothing within that time, the creditor can ask the court to issue an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid), which can then be used to enforce the debt against you (e.g. by a bailiff). If you are unsure whether the claim is valid, consider getting legal advice (e.g. from a consumer advice centre or lawyer) before the deadline passes.
